responses.sql: SELECT e.status AS status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS avg_amount_minus_spent, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status

assumptions.assumption: "Higher-spending" with a cutoff of 6.0 means strictly greater than 6.0 (spent > 6.0), so lines with spent exactly 6.0 are excluded.
"Status" refers to event.status (the status of the linked event), not budget.event_status.

The count is the number of qualifying budget lines per status; rows where amount or spent is NULL are excluded from the average by AVG, and the average is NULL if no values exist. Lines with NULL spent are excluded by the filter anyway.

alternatives.interpretation: Cutoff is inclusive: budget lines with spent >= 6.0 are considered.

assumptions.assumption: "Higher-spending" with a cutoff of 6.0 means strictly greater than 6.0 (spent > 6.0), so lines with spent exactly 6.0 are excluded.

The count is of budget lines that pass the spent filter and join to an event; lines with NULL amount or spent are excluded by the filter (NULL spent) or yield NULL in the average (NULL amount) but are still counted if spent > 6.0.
